name: Margin
description: Design system for the Margin research report. Source of truth for colour, type, grid, spacing, route geometry and motion. Edit this file, then run `npm run margin:tokens` to regenerate css/tokens.css.

paper.role: Page ground and cards. White, as the reference's sheets.
paper.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Card white.

paper-deep.role: Quiet chips, mounts, placeholders, slips. The only grey fill.
paper-deep.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Unselected chip.

route.role: The route and its nodes, notes, folios, the one mark that matters. Movement, events.
route.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Red screen.

blue.role: Headlines, stations, figures, body copy, blue fields. Time, evidence, voice.
blue.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Blue screen and ground.

mustard.role: Yellow. A field colour: insight cards, highlights, stickers, chips. Never text; text on it is ink.
mustard.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Yellow screen and ground. Key kept as 'mustard' for compatibility.

ink.role: Text on yellow, artifacts, device frames, stamps.
ink.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Illustration ink.

sky.role: A selected chip or filter. Small areas only.
sky.basis: Sampled from the client's third reference (app screens on colour fields). Selected chip.

stone.role: Data only: diverging midpoint and no-data cells. Never text.
stone.basis: A cool grey between chip grey and ink, no hue.

blue-1.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude. Light to dark, one hue.
blue-1.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-2.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude. Light to dark, one hue.
blue-2.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-3.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude. Light to dark, one hue.
blue-3.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-4.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude. Light to dark, one hue.
blue-4.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-5.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude. Light to dark, one hue.
blue-5.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

display.role: Headers and sub-headers: headlines, section heads, primary lines, figures, stations.
display.basis: Client choice, after two reference images. Google Fonts, SIL OFL. Single weight; the rupee sign is drawn from Nunito Sans 700 inside the same family.

text.basis: One typeface for the whole system, per the client's typography analysis.

display-xl.use: Chapter and spread headlines. 22px / 600 in the analysis.
display-xl.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

display-l.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

closing.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

station.use: Day, date or time in a route break. 18px / 600.
station.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

stat.use: A figure or time. 18px / 600, the same face with stronger weight.
stat.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

heading.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

quote.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

body.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

label.use: Codes and small labels. 11 to 12px, tracking about +0.4px.
label.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

folio.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

note.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

caption.use: Microcopy and captions. Muted by opacity, not by a separate style.
caption.basis: Client typography analysis (app reference), px converted to pt at 0.75.

page.basis: A4 portrait pages read as spreads, like the reference book. Six columns per page give the route room to turn without every block sitting on a column.

space.basis: Every route turn, text inset and node gap is a multiple of 2mm, so loose compositions still align.

weight.basis: Reduced for a lighter line, closer to the app reference.

node.basis: Terminal dot three times the line weight.

radius.basis: Every turn is rounded. Radius is clamped to half the shorter segment.

break-gap.basis: Space between a node and the station label in its break.

dash.basis: Dashed route: story interrupted or hypothesis.

hairline.basis: Leader lines to a precise point.

text-inset.basis: Minimum distance from route centre to text it encloses.

draw.use: Screen only: the route draws itself on first view.

node.use: A node appears as the line reaches it.

fade.use: Text beside a node fades in after the node.

para.basis: Extra space between paragraphs: 7.7px on a 13.9px body in the reference.

snug.basis: Sub-heading to its figure or paragraph.

gutter.basis: Between side-by-side columns: 18px in the reference.

measure.basis: Body column width: 267px in the reference.

fill.basis: Frosted pills on the reference's colour screens.

fill-strong.basis: Frost on yellow and on light photographs.

edge.basis: Hairline edge that separates frost from its field.

radius.basis: Pills and circles are fully round.

sheet-radius.basis: White sheet over a colour field, as the reference's cards.

stroke.basis: Outlines of pills, tags and rules. Reduced from 0.45mm.
